hero.heading: Leander ISD Calendar 2026-2027
hero.mobileDescription: School starts Aug. 12 and ends May 27. Leander ISD also has October and February mid-semester breaks, while high schools follow a separate A/B calendar.
hero.desktopDescription: Leander ISD starts the 2026-27 school year on Wednesday, Aug. 12, 2026, and ends Thursday, May 27, 2027, with early release on the last day. The approved calendar includes a full week for Fall Break, two weeks for Winter Break and one week for Spring Break, plus shorter October and February breaks. High schools follow a separate A/B calendar, including a C Day on Oct. 20.

editorialSummary.heading: What Leander ISD families should know for 2026-2027
highlights: First day Wednesday, August 12, and last day Thursday, May 27
Winter Break ends January 1; students return January 5 after a no-school professional-learning day
High schools start and finish on A Days, with a C Day on October 20
paragraphs: Some Leander ISD no-school stretches are longer than the named breaks alone. Professional-learning days connect with weekends or student/staff breaks in October, early January, February and late March.

Students are out Sept. 7 and Sept. 21. In October, there is no school Friday, Oct. 9, followed by the Oct. 12–13 student/staff break, giving students five straight days away from class including the weekend. The district's Continuous Improvement Conference on Nov. 2–3 is also a student no-school period, followed later that month by Fall Break from Nov. 23–27.

Dec. 18 is an early-release day. Winter Break runs Dec. 21 through Jan. 1, and Jan. 4 is a professional-learning day with no school, so students return Tuesday, Jan. 5. In February, students are also out Feb. 12 and Feb. 15–16. Spring Break runs March 15–19, followed later in the month by no-school dates on March 26 and March 29.

High schools use a separate A/B calendar. The year begins and ends on A Days, Oct. 20 is marked as a C Day, and the calendar lists six grading periods. The high school PDF also shows April 5–30 as a proposed STAAR testing window, not a test date for every student.

comparativeInsights: October 9 and October 12–13 form one continuous five-day student break when the weekend is included; classes resume October 14.
Winter Break officially runs December 21–January 1, and the January 4 professional-learning day extends the continuous student break through Monday.
February 12 and February 15–16 connect across the weekend, giving students five consecutive calendar days without classes.
The March 26 student/staff break and March 29 professional-learning day create a four-day student break across the weekend.
The high school A/B calendar supplements the districtwide calendar; it adds schedule-day labels, six-week grading periods and a proposed testing window without changing district holidays.

about.processing: Canonical events keep the distinct no-school dates and reasons shown in the source calendars. October 9 and October 12–13, Winter Break and January 4, February 12 and February 15–16, and March 26 and March 29 remain separate events. The breaks array holds derived student time-off ranges, including intervening weekends. Staff-only summer schedules, board meetings and campus activities outside the academic schedule are excluded.
about.updates: The Essentials PDF controls districtwide attendance dates; the high school PDF supplements it with schedule-day and grading-period details. Proposed testing dates may change, and campus bell schedules or special programs may publish additional instructions.
about.disclaimer: This independent reference is not operated by Leander ISD. Families should confirm testing assignments, report-card timing, transportation, campus events, emergency changes and program-specific schedules with the district or their child's school.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for Leander ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first day for Leander ISD students is Wednesday, August 12, 2026. High schools begin on an A Day, and their first six-week grading period starts the same day.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for Leander ISD in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. All schools dismiss early, and high schools finish on an A Day at the end of the sixth grading period.

faqs.question: How long is the Leander ISD October break?
faqs.answer: Students are off Friday, October 9, for conferences and professional learning, followed by the October 12–13 student/staff break. Those dates connect across the weekend, creating five consecutive days without classes. Students return Wednesday, October 14.

faqs.question: When is Leander ISD Thanksgiving break in 2026?
faqs.answer: The district calls it Fall Break, and it runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Students and staff return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Leander ISD winter break in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Leander ISD Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a professional-learning day with no school for students, so classes resume Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: When do Leander ISD students return after winter break?
faqs.answer: Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. Winter Break ends January 1, and January 4 is a separate professional-learning day with no school for students.

faqs.question: Is there school in Leander ISD on January 4, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 4, is a professional-learning day with no school for students. Classes resume Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: Does Leander ISD have a February break?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students are off Friday, February 12, for professional learning and Monday and Tuesday, February 15–16, for a student/staff break. With the weekend, that creates five consecutive days without classes. Students return February 17.

faqs.question: When is Leander ISD spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15, through Friday, March 19, 2027. Students and staff return Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Is there school in Leander ISD on March 26, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, March 26, is a student/staff break. Students also have no school Monday, March 29, for professional learning and return Tuesday, March 30.

faqs.question: Is there school in Leander ISD on March 29, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, March 29, is a professional-learning day with no school for students. It follows the March 26 student/staff break and weekend; classes resume Tuesday, March 30.

faqs.question: Is there school in Leander ISD on April 26, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, April 26, is a professional-learning day and students do not attend. Classes resume Tuesday, April 27.

faqs.question: What are the Leander ISD early-release dates and dismissal times?
faqs.answer: Early release is scheduled for December 18, 2026, and May 27, 2027. Elementary schools dismiss at 11:30 a.m., middle schools at 1:05 p.m. and high schools at 12:15 p.m.

faqs.question: Are there afternoon Pre-K classes on Leander ISD early-release days?
faqs.answer: No half-day PreK 3 PM classes are held on December 18 or May 27. Full-day PreK 3 and PreK 4 run 7:30–11:30 a.m.; listed half-day morning programs run 7:30–10:15 a.m.

faqs.question: What are the regular Leander ISD school hours?
faqs.answer: Elementary schools run 7:30 a.m.–2:50 p.m., middle schools 9:00 a.m.–4:20 p.m. and high schools 8:15 a.m.–3:35 p.m. Families should confirm campus-specific schedules with their school.

faqs.question: How does the Leander ISD high school A/B schedule work?
faqs.answer: High school A and B days alternate across student attendance days; holidays and professional-learning days do not carry an A/B label. The year starts on an A Day and ends on an early-release A Day.

faqs.question: When is the Leander ISD high school C Day?
faqs.answer: The high school calendar marks Tuesday, October 20, 2026, as a C Day.

faqs.question: What are the Leander ISD high school grading periods?
faqs.answer: The six periods run August 12–September 18, September 22–October 30, November 4–December 18, January 5–February 19, February 22–April 16 and April 19–May 27.

faqs.question: When is the proposed Leander ISD high school STAAR window?
faqs.answer: The high school PDF marks April 5–30, 2027, as a proposed STAAR testing window. Specific subjects, grades and test dates may vary, so students should confirm their assigned testing schedule.

faqs.question: Is there school in Leander ISD on September 21, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 21, is a professional-learning day with no school for students. Classes resume Tuesday, September 22.

faqs.question: Do Leander ISD students have school November 2–3, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. November 2–3 are the district's Continuous Improvement Conference, and students do not attend. Classes resume Wednesday, November 4.

faqs.question: When are Leander ISD report cards issued?
faqs.answer: The high school PDF shows grading-period boundaries but does not publish report-card release dates. Families should check campus communications for posting dates.

faqs.question: Does the Leander ISD A/B calendar apply to elementary and middle schools?
faqs.answer: No. The A/B/C labels and six-week grading periods shown here come from the district high school calendar. Elementary and middle school families should use the Essentials calendar and their campus schedule.

faqs.question: Where can families download the official Leander ISD calendars?
faqs.answer: The official Leander ISD calendar page links both the Essentials PDF and the separate High School A/B Schedule PDF. Families should use that page for the latest versions and schedule notices.
